items.title: SEC charges for insider trading against Andreas Bechtolsheim (co-founder, then Arista's chairman), for trading Acacia Communications options in 2019 on the basis of non-public information regarding its imminent acquisition by Cisco.
items.outcome: Final consent judgment on 30/05/2024: civil penalty of 923 740$, bar from serving as an officer/director of a listed company for 5 years (without admitting or denying the facts) - explains Bechtolsheim's change of title (from Chairman to Chief Development Officer/Chief Architect).
items.source: SEC Litigation Release No. 25955 (26/03/2024) et No. 26014 (03/06/2024)

dernierCall.guidanceProchainTrimestre: Q3 2026: revenue ~$3.3B (vs consensus ~$2.94-2.95B), non-GAAP gross margin ~63%, non-GAAP operating margin 48-49%, non-GAAP diluted EPS $1.06-1.08 (vs consensus ~$0.91-0.92 pre-print), tax rate ~21.5%.
dernierCall.guidanceAnnuelle: FY26 revenue raised to ~$12.6B (+40%, third raise this year; +$1.1B vs May's $11.5B, +$2.1B vs the $10.5B Analyst Day goal), non-GAAP gross margin 62-64% maintained (inclusive of expected memory/silicon cost increases), non-GAAP operating margin raised to 48-49%. AI fabrics goal kept at >=$3.5B, campus at >=$1.25B; guidance explicitly capped by secured supply, with upside if supply loosens.
pointsCles: First quarter ever above $3B in revenue ($3,035.7M, +37.7%), with a broad-based beat: international jumped to 23% of revenue (vs 15.5% in Q1) and the CEO stressed the FY26 raise comes from ALL product sectors (AI, core data center, enterprise, campus, routing), not AI alone.

Etherlink AI fabric customer base now exceeds 100 cumulative customers (vs 4-5 in 2024); multi-year purchase commitments nearly tripled year-over-year to $9.7B, memory supply secured into 2027, and a liquid-cooling supply chain established - management calls industry supply tightness a 'two-year problem' through 2028 but says Arista's H1 actions will pay off in H2.

New 7060X-E7 platform (100Tbps system capacity, 1.6Tbps throughput, first liquid-cooled options); 1.6T trials with a single-digit number of very large customers in H2 26, real production expected in 2027 (mirroring the 800G cycle). Scale-across positioned as ~30% of the 2026 AI target, in a market management sizes at $3-4B today growing to $15-20B by 2030.

No share buybacks in the quarter ($817.9M remaining on the program) as cash is prioritized toward supply commitments; Q2 gross margin 63.4% (+100bp sequential) helped by ~20-30bp of tariff refunds and customer mix, with announced price increases only benefiting late 2026/2027 due to backlog.

hypothese.summary: High-speed switching leader fully engaged in the AI networking wave: Q2 26 marks the first quarter above 3 Md$ of revenue (+37,7%), with FY26 guidance raised for the 3rd time this year (~12,6 Md$, operating margin 48-49%). More than 100 Etherlink AI fabric customers (vs 4-5 in 2024) and nearly tripled multi-year purchase commitments (9,7 Md$) confirm the demand trajectory, tempered by an industry-wide supply constraint that the CEO judges will last until 2028. omniumEPS 4,05->8,52 (2026-2030).
hypothese.text:
== THESIS SUMMARY ==
Arista is the switching layer of the AI build-out: FY26 revenue guidance raised for the THIRD time this year to ~12.6bn (+40%; 11.5bn guided in May), with the increment coming from all segments per the CEO - AI, enterprise, campus, routing - not just AI fabric. Q2: revenue 3,035.7M (+37.7%, well above consensus), non-GAAP EPS 1.02 (+15% beat), GM 63.4% (+100bp sequential). The AI customer base broadened to >100 Etherlink fabric customers (vs 4-5 early 2024) and multi-year purchase commitments reached 9.7bn (vs 3.6bn), securing memory supply into 2027.

== THESIS READ ==
- Breadth is the new signal: the raise is NOT AI-only - enterprise/campus/routing all contribute, de-risking the hyperscaler concentration story at the margin. Watch: Microsoft/Meta revenue share disclosure at 10-K.
- Buybacks suspended (0 in H1 vs 983M) to fund supply commitments - cash preservation over EPS optics; graduated resumption assumed from 2027. Watch: Q3/Q4 buyback line.
- Component tightness a 'two-year problem' (through 2028) per the CEO - Arista's secured supply is a competitive moat while it lasts. Watch: 1.6T (7060X-E7) real production ramp in 2027 and the scale-across market (3-4bn today, 15-20bn by 2030 per management).

== SPECIAL FACTORS ==
'data' = published GAAP; adjXXX close to non-GAAP (the company only guides non-GAAP) - basis wedge documented in the scorecard. Net cash 12.4bn growing to ~37bn by 2030 despite commitments; ETR 21% normative (FY25 actual ~18.5% on excess tax benefits, documented).

== PARAMETERS & WATCH-LIST ==
2026: revenue 12.6bn (guidance), OM ~48.5% non-GAAP; 2027-2030: +25%/yr fading to +15%, margin held ~47-48.5%; finNet = interest income on net cash (~3%); shares roughly flat then declining as buybacks resume. Watch: OM holding the 48-49% band if component costs re-tighten; AI vs non-AI increment split; concentration.

== CATALYSTS ==
Q3 (early Nov); 1.6T production milestones (2027); buyback resumption; hyperscaler capex prints.

ancrages.moteur: FY26 guidance raised for the 3rd time this year at Q2 26 (revenue ~12,6 Md$, +1,1Md$ vs May; non-GAAP operating margin 48-49%), the increment coming from all product segments according to the CEO.

Etherlink AI fabric customer base up from 4-5 (2024) to more than 100 at end-Q2 26, multi-year purchase commitments nearly tripled to 9,7 Md$ (vs 3,6 Md$ a year earlier) - strong demand visibility over 2027-2028.

The CEO describes the supply constraint as a "two-year problem" at industry level (until 2028), capping the margin below a full normalisation despite the improvement already tangible and specific to Arista (tariff refunds, newly qualified suppliers).

Buybacks suspended in H1 2026 (0$ vs 983 M$ in H1 2025) to preserve cash against the 9,7 Md$ of multi-year purchase commitments - gradual resumption assumed from 2027 as visibility on the payments improves.

"Scale-across" market assessed by management at 3-4 Md$ today, expanding towards 15-20 Md$ by 2030 (Arista would be targeting ~1,2 Md$ in 2026, i.e. ~30% of its AI target) - an additional growth driver not yet fully reflected in the official AI target.
Cash and marketable securities now exceeding 13,3 Md$ (vs 10,7 Md$ at end-2025), with no debt - rising financial income as FCF accumulates, net of a gradual resumption of buybacks.
